Seed store

The tin is locked away at night by one of the key holders.

Packets of saved seed are kept in the tin by the door. Take what you will sow this year and leave some for the members who come after you. Write what you took on the sheet inside the lid, so that the committee knows what to buy in for next spring.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
